description: Everything a business's Nearwick page says: what and where it is, its website, opening hours and description where listed, what its own website states and when that was read, dated checks, and whether the business manages the page. Use the country code and the slug from its page address (/{country}/b/{slug}).

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, such as GH for Ghana or CA for Canada.

slug.description: The business's slug, from search_businesses or its page address.
